configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Debug development build: the TDD red-green loop preset; exports compile_commands.json for clang-tidy

configurePresets.name: rel
configurePresets.description: -O3 -g -DNDEBUG; -g feeds perf --call-graph dwarf, no codegen change

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: -O1 -g ASan+UBSan; -fno-sanitize-recover=all so any UB hit fails the run instead of logging past it

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: -O1 -g TSan; gains real work at (SPSC telemetry ring producer/consumer stress)

testPresets.name: correctness-base
testPresets.description: Shared base for every CORRECTNESS test preset: the wall-clock-bounded `perf` label is excluded exactly ONCE here. Copy-pasting that filter per preset made the safety property opt-out-per-preset — one forgotten line in a future sanitizer/CI preset silently re-arms a timing test inside a correctness gate, and it passes almost always.
